name: Ouroboros Energy Wireless Neural Interface Charging
product_name: Ouroboros Energy Wireless Neural Interface Charging
description: A technology that enables neural interfaces to be charged wirelessly through ambient electromagnetic energy in equipped environments, eliminating the need for physical charging sessions. WNIC uses resonant inductive coupling tuned to neural interface power systems, transmitting energy through dedicated emitters installed in walls, ceilings, and furniture. In WNIC-equipped spaces, neural interfaces charge passively and continuously, never running low on power. Ouroboros has deployed the technology in corporate offices, premium residential buildings, and public spaces in upper-tier districts.
enables: Continuous neural interface power without charging sessions
social_impact: WNIC has eliminated one of the few remaining vulnerabilities of neural augmentation — the need to periodically charge the interface, during which functionality is reduced. In WNIC-equipped environments, augmented individuals never experience diminished capability, while unequipped environments become zones of anxiety where interface power levels are constantly monitored. The technology has created a geographic dependency — leaving WNIC zones means returning to manual charging, which many long-term users find psychologically distressing.
story_hooks: A WNIC installation has been modified to deliver a subtle data payload along with the charging signal — every neural interface in the building is receiving firmware modifications during routine charging.
A WNIC dead zone has appeared in a previously equipped district — someone is jamming the wireless charging frequency, and augmented residents are experiencing simultaneous interface brownouts.
